errors.text_span: The purple line starts at approximately 2.74 and decreases steadily to around 2.52
errors.evidence: The figure shows the purple Vanilla line starting near 2.75 (at about 0.10 TFLOPs) and ending near 2.50 (at about 1.20 TFLOPs), not 2.74 to 2.52.

errors.text_span: The red line begins at about 2.73 and also decreases steadily to approximately 2.48
errors.evidence: The figure shows the red SepLLM line starting near 2.70–2.74 (about 0.10 TFLOPs) and ending closer to 2.47–2.48; the stated start value 2.73 is not clearly supported by the plot and understates the visible initial loss of the red curve relative to the first point.

The description omits the green dashed reference construction: the horizontal dashed line at loss 2.5, the two vertical green dashed lines, the green star markers, the bracket-like green line, and the '1.28x' annotation in the upper-right of the plot.
